data.name: New Elysium
data.detailed_description:
A NARRATIVE EXPERIENCE WHERE EVERY CHOICE MATTERS

New Elysium is an interactive drama in which you play as Zoé, a young girl discovering the strange world of an island praised for its perfection.
Through her eyes, her emotions, and her decisions, you explore a heartfelt story where every choice can shape your path.

A UTOPIAN ISLAND… AT FIRST GLANCE

Cut off from the rest of the world, New Elysium is presented as a modern paradise: clean, peaceful, safe.
But as Zoé walks its streets, she begins to realize the island hides far more than it shows.

Some places feel unnervingly strange.
Some rules seem too rigid.
Some people avoid answering simple questions.

Without ever giving easy answers, the story invites you to feel both the beauty of the island… and the shadows beneath it.

A CINEMATIC AND EMOTIONAL EXPERIENCE

New Elysium blends interactive storytelling, exploration, and psychological tension:

🎬 Powerful, cinematic cutscenes
🎮 Meaningful narrative choices
⚡ Precise, immersive QTEs
🔫 Moderate but impactful action sequences
🌫️ Exploration driven by emotion, tension, and survival

Every scene is crafted as a cinematic moment.
Every decision leaves its mark.
And some choices—sometimes subtle—will echo all the way to the end.

A STORY OF HUMANITY, LOVE, AND SACRIFICE

The game explores themes such as:

  • the fear of losing loved ones

  • sacrifice

  • bonds forged through chaos

  • manipulation and political secrets

  • survival in the face of collapse

  • the need to keep believing in something

Relationships evolve based on your decisions, including deeper emotional or intimate connections that can influence the course of the story.

A UTOPIA HIDING A SECRET

Behind the perfect image of New Elysium lies something hidden.
Something that caused its downfall.
A lie buried beneath ruins and propaganda.

The truth is never handed to you.
By progressing, exploring, observing, and deciding, you will piece together what reshaped the city—and why Zoé can never go back.

CHOICES THAT SHAPE DESTINY

Your decisions influence:

✨ character relationships
✨ Zoé’s personal journey
✨ access to certain information
✨ who survives—and who doesn’t
✨ multiple possible endings

A single choice may shatter an already fragile world.
Or rebuild the foundations of a new one.

data.short_description: “A single wingbeat can destroy everything.” New Elysium is a cinematic narrative drama where every choice reshapes the story. Explore a shattered utopia, survive the night, and decide the final wingbeat of destiny.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD equivalent / Intel UHD 620
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
  • VR Support: None / N/A
  • Additional Notes: N/A
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / RX 560 / Intel Iris Xe
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
  • VR Support: None / N/A
  • Additional Notes: N/A
